messages:
leo: Thanks for the all-hands finance segment / quick question: did the runway target change or are we staying at the same baseline?

maria: Baseline remains 18 months at current burn. FP&A is running conservative/base/optimistic scenarios and will publish the slides by Fri.

cfo_lee: Were also preparing a simple cash waterfall to show runway sensitivity to hiring and major vendor commitments.

eng_ravi: Minor engineering question: if a vendor only accepts card for cloud credits, what's the maximum we can approve via p-card or virtual card?

procurement_amy: Short answer: p-card single txn cap = $2k, default monthly cap = $5k. For vendors that require card, procurement can issue a virtual card up to $10k with manager + finance approval. Anything > $10k needs invoice/PO and procurement review. We prefer invoices for auditability.

leo: If we have a production incident and need short-term reserved capacity, can teams bypass the normal lead time?

maria: Use the procurement intake and mark the ticket "expedite" + tag "prod_impact". Finance/procurement triage expedited requests within 24 business hours. Temporary approvals are limited to 90 days unless converted to a formal commit with legal/finance sign-off.

hr_zoe: Any update to hiring-pause rules or approver matrix?

cfo_lee: No rule changes. Triggers: sustained gross burn >10% vs plan OR bookings < plan by >15% for a full month. Exception approvals now require VP + Finance + HR sign-off for headcount additions during a slowdown.

eng_ravi: Who should we loop in for vendor payment-term negotiations (net-30 vs net-60)?

procurement_amy: Procurement owns negotiation; finance signs off on cash impact. For strategic vendors we aim for net-60 or milestone payments where feasible  contact vendor-ops@redwood.com and cc finance-ops.

leo: Will there be a single FAQ or flowchart to point teams at?

procurement_amy: Yes  well publish a one-page procurement flowchart + a tiny FAQ in the handbook by Wed EOD and post the link here.

finance-bot: New ticket PROC-461 created: "p-card virtual card policy" (assigned to procurement).

leo: Awesome, please ping eng leads when the doc is live. :pray:
